title: BoldCreate plugin metadata
description: Extra metadata BoldCreate Connect needs that the Cursor and Claude manifests have no field for.

phase.description: Rollout phase this plugin belongs to.

wave.description: Test wave. A = token or no auth, B = OAuth.

transport.description: MCP transport. Required for MCP plugins. BoldCreate Connect supports streamable-http only today.

auth.description: Auth this package is configured for. Required for MCP plugins.

alternativeAuth.description: Other auth methods the server supports.

hostedBy.description: Who runs the MCP server. Required for MCP plugins. customer = the customer hosts it (for example gitea-mcp next to their Gitea).

stage.description: Launch stage: the vendor's stage for an MCP server, or the plugin's own stage for a first-party plugin.

oauthScopes.description: OAuth scopes to request, for servers that need them (Google).

upstream.description: Where a community plugin was copied from. The original LICENSE file stays in the plugin folder.

path.description: Plugin folder inside the source repository.

author.description: Author named in the source manifest.
